newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela hopes to firm up Mobil deal early in '98.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela hopes to firm up Mobil deal early in '98.

text.p: Mobil Corp and Venezuela's state-owned Pequiven hope to sign a binding agreement for their $1.6 billion olefins joint venture in the first quarter of next year, a Pequiven source said on Wednesday.
A preliminary agreement was signed in January and the joint- venture company had been planned for late this year.

The project, at Jose, a seashore petrochemicals site in eastern Anzoategui state, includes the construction of one olefins plant with 830,000 tonnes annual capacity, two polyethylene plants with a combined capacity of 480,000 tonnes a year and one plant producing 430,000 tonnes per year of glycol.
Start-up for the complex was scheduled for the year 2000, although Arnold Volkenborn, Pequiven president, hinted on Wednesday it might take until 2001.
